title: Customer-value stages and the one gap to close
origin: ClimbOS synthesis (original proposal) from the member frameworks; author guidance is cited by finding id, proposed rules are labelled 'proposed'.
decision_task: How to map the customer's journey into value stages, pick one customer-led measure per stage and choose the single gap worth closing, sized in customers.
applies_when: Owner tracks only signups and sales
exclusions: One-off purchases where a purchase funnel plus reviews and referrals is enough
required_inputs: Counts per stage over the same period
Definition of first value (value received, not setup)
evidence_requirements: Which events the owner can observe
Customer statements of value mapped to features or service elements
Event or job data per customer
Later paid/retained outcome per customer for validation
Counts reaching each milestone in a period
customer or unit growth over 12 months with the starting base
market flux signals: new regulation, new technology, new area, shortage, new category
whether buyers ask 'who can do this?' or compare prices
missing_data_behavior: Stage counts missing: name the measurement step; no gap ranking.
Thresholds set by judgement: label them; check against later payment when cohorts allow.

decision_branches.then: Size each by extra customers (eligible x lift x downstream rate), not rate alone.
Treat upgrades by existing customers as retention, not conversion.
Mark the research and stage map stale; refresh before planning.

implementation_steps: Place evidence under thinking, doing, feeling per phase
Split into milestones where feelings shift
Map each milestone to a diagnosis.ts stage (Problem→reach, Interest→lead, First Value→activation, Value Realization→activation(value)/purchase, Continued Value→retention, Value Growth→no stage today)
Note where payment happens for this business
List what customers said was valuable per milestone
Map each to the feature or service element that delivers it
Write a trackable action (with threshold if data supports) per milestone
Walk each milestone as the chosen-Job customer: their search places, ads, homepage, signup, first use, emails, renewal
Every play states the Job, milestone and KPI it moves
Review KPI dashboard on a fixed cadence
Log which gap is being worked and which are parked
Compute 12-month unit growth in code and keep the base
Collect market flux signals separately from own growth
dependencies: Some way to observe at least one value event

cash_and_labor_requirements.labor: A half-day workshop equivalent; ClimbOS drafts from research
cash_and_labor_requirements.measurement: At least one value event per phase eventually

metrics: Milestones with an observable KPI / total milestones
Rate reaching each milestone KPI within window
Paid/retained rate conditional on reaching vs not
Milestone KPI rate for new cohorts
Share of plays tagged to the chosen Job's milestone
share of new customers on contracts or follow-on offers
guardrails: NPS and CSAT stay out of diagnosis (leading indicators at most).
Sizing lifts are illustrative, labelled assumptions.
Stages with no data marked unmeasured, not guessed
Rates computed in code with denominators
Pair any milestone lift with downstream paid or retained outcome
Lift claims carry window, cohort and comparison
Book case uplifts never used as forecasts
Customer-facing sends follow consent rules (lifecycle email only to consented contacts; Resend never for cold)
Tags are checked by code, not trusted from prose
Stage is a labelled heuristic, never a computed certainty
Takeoff never overrides cash floor, capacity or payback guardrails
alternatives_when_constrained: No research: draft milestones from owner interview, labelled owner-reported
No event data: owner hand-marks a sample of recent customers per milestone
No tracking: weekly owner count from admin view
Service business: milestone = job delivered, problem gone, rebooked
No counts: owner hand-checks last 20 signups through each milestone
Low volume: before/after on whole weeks, labelled directional
No dashboard: monthly manual counts per milestone
No growth data: ask for customer counts 12 months ago and now
No market signals: default to stability rules for spending
stop_conditions: Research for the Job is older than ~12 months or the product changed: refresh
KPI reachers do not pay/retain better than non-reachers: move the definition
Nearly everyone reaches it: it is setup, move later
No change after planned weeks: gap cause was elsewhere
Milestone up, paid flat: look at offer or price (PB-activation-repair revise)
Over half the plays target other milestones than the chosen gap: re-focus or justify
Review each quarter or when growth slows sharply; a boom ending is the moment arbitrage arrives
review_triggers: Owner's numbers or business type change
A dated benchmark this playbook mentions is superseded
Shared metric across teams causing misattribution
Picking the most fun or trendy idea
Fixing several gaps at once and learning nothing
Plays not tied to any milestone
Reading 100% growth from a tiny base as market takeoff
Using the 30-40% cutoff as a law

missing_prerequisite.rule: proposed: for recurring-revenue types, the diagnosis reports a retention reading and, when supplied, an expansion reading (upgrades, added seats, referrals); missing Growth-phase numbers are listed in 'missing'.
proposed: a milestone threshold is 'validated' only when reachers' later paid or retained rate exceeds non-reachers' in the same cohort; otherwise label 'hypothesis'.
proposed: the owner's 'visitors' input asks for new unique visitors and excludes logged-in customers.

strategic_preference.rule: proposed: stage labels shown to the owner use the business's own milestone names where defined, while code keeps the fixed stage keys.
proposed: BRP-07 v2 extends the value-event definition to every milestone, including Continued Value (value KPI per natural period) and Value Growth (plus upgrade, review or referral).
proposed: book case uplifts (2x, +93%, +64%) appear only as labelled historical examples, never as expected results.
proposed: each play carries a milestone tag and the chosen Job id; lint flags plans where the bankable play is not on the chosen gap.
proposed: in a takeoff branch, prefer plays that convert new customers onto recurring or embedded arrangements over one-off sales

contextual_heuristic.rule: proposed: one-off purchase businesses keep the purchase funnel; ClimbOS does not force a Growth-phase map on them.
proposed: NPS/CSAT may be reported but never used as a milestone KPI or a diagnosis input.
proposed: plans include a 'walk the journey' first step that lists mismatches per milestone, labelled as hypotheses.
proposed: research older than 12 months or predating a pricing/product change is shown as stale.
proposed: compute stage only when the 12-month starting base is at least a minimum count (owner-configurable; e.g. 30 customers); otherwise stage = unknown

economic_feasibility.rule: proposed: when two measured gaps compete, code reports added customers and contribution for the same point lift at each stage (eligible x lift x downstream rate x value) next to the rate comparison.
proposed: when stage is stability or unknown, affordable CAC must not include unobserved lock-in lifetimes

reconciliation_note: The book rejects a funnel that ends at purchase, not stage ratios; ClimbOS diagnosis keeps ratios on value stages (RECONCILIATION R09).
